main_body: Wooden display counter (rows 22-31) topped by a glass dome with a tiered cake, drawn straight from the front
top_band: Reading the middle column: rows 10-11 blue dome arc, rows 12-21 pale glass and cake seen face-on, rows 22-23 orange wood edge (about 2px), row 23 dark line, then the front face. No horizontal top surface is visible.
evidence: The counter has only a 1-2px orange lip over a dark line, which is a rim, not a surface. Its front face has inset drawer panels. The dome is a flat front-view semicircle and the cake tiers are stacked face-on, so no tabletop or dome base is seen from above. This is a front elevation. It is also a low counter with a dome, not tall furniture.

style.evidence: The wood base has about 4 tones (light orange, mid, dark, deep brown) with little grain. The glass dome is a large, nearly flat pale-blue fill with only a thin highlight edge. The cake has 3-4 tones but no texture dots. The dark brown outline near the wood is acceptable, but the dome edge is a uniform blue ring. Tiles carry only about 3-5 colours, well below the stall and well references, which have tile scallops, grain and speckle.
